results.note: The museum's official visitor information page lists general adult admission at $15.00. Open Wed–Sun 10am–5pm. Third-party sites show older prices of $8–$10.

The NPS fees page lists adult tickets at $30.00 for both the apartment tour and the walking tour. Online and phone orders may add a service fee. The Tenement Museum's own site returned a 403, so I used the NPS page.

A search snippet of the official Visit page showed adults at $28, seniors $24 and students $19. Direct fetches of the New Museum pages returned nothing, so I could not confirm this on the page itself. An older January 2025 press release listed adults at $25. Thursday 7–9pm is pay-what-you-wish.

The official tickets page lists adult (13+) general admission at $22.95. It includes the main zoo, the Tisch Children's Zoo and one 4-D Theater visit. A search result mentioned a cheaper limited ticket at $13.95, but I couldn't confirm it on the official page, so I did not use it.
